title: Schedule of Benefits: Pharmacy Benefit Plan Deductible by Design
content:
Each Pharmacy Benefit Plan design sets an annual pharmacy deductible for the plan year: an individual amount, a family amount (all family enrollments of one subscriber combined), whether the deductible is embedded or aggregate, and the formulary tiers whose claims are subject to it.

## Deductible amounts and structure

| Plan design | Individual deductible (USD) | Family deductible (USD) | Structure | Formulary tiers subject to the deductible |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Rx HSA Saver | 2000.00 | 4000.00 | Aggregate | Tiers 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 |
| Northbridge Rx Basic | 300.00 | 900.00 | Embedded | Tiers 2, 3, 4 and 5 |
| Northbridge Rx Value | 200.00 | 600.00 | Embedded | Tiers 2, 3, 4 and 5 |
| Northbridge Rx Select | 150.00 | 450.00 | Embedded | Tiers 3, 4 and 5 |
| Northbridge Rx Plus | 0.00 | 0.00 | Embedded | None (no tier is subject to a deductible) |
| Northbridge Rx Premier | 0.00 | 0.00 | Embedded | None (no tier is subject to a deductible) |

**Embedded** means each member stops paying deductible once the individual amount is met, even if the family amount is not. **Aggregate** means that, when coverage is not employee-only, no member is past the deductible until the family amount is met.

## Drugs that skip the deductible

| Plan design | Northbridge Rx Preventive Drug List skips the deductible | Insulin products skip the deductible (and are charged the insulin cap) |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Rx HSA Saver | Yes | Yes |
| Northbridge Rx Basic | Yes | Yes |
| Northbridge Rx Value | Yes | Yes |
| Northbridge Rx Select | Yes | Yes |
| Northbridge Rx Plus | Yes | Yes |
| Northbridge Rx Premier | Yes | Yes |

A drug on the Northbridge Rx Preventive Drug List goes straight to tier cost share on every design.

## Fourth-quarter deductible carryover

| Plan design | Fourth-quarter carryover | First month of the carryover period |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Rx HSA Saver | No | month 10 (October) |
| Northbridge Rx Basic | No | month 10 (October) |
| Northbridge Rx Value | Yes | month 10 (October) |
| Northbridge Rx Select | Yes | month 10 (October) |
| Northbridge Rx Plus | No | month 10 (October) |
| Northbridge Rx Premier | No | month 10 (October) |

Where carryover is Yes, deductible amounts incurred in the last calendar quarter of a plan year, from the first day of month 10 onward, are credited to the next plan year's deductible. Where it is No, the month setting has no effect, because nothing carries over.

## Points of reading

- A tier 1 generic claim under Northbridge Rx Basic or Northbridge Rx Value is not subject to the deductible; under Northbridge Rx Select neither tier 1 nor tier 2 is.
- Under Northbridge Rx HSA Saver every tier, generics included, is subject to the deductible, and the family amount of 4000.00 governs any coverage level other than employee-only because the structure is aggregate.
- Northbridge Rx Plus and Northbridge Rx Premier have no pharmacy deductible at all.
